basic_profile.bio: A 37-year-old self-taught tech enthusiast from Seattle, Washington. I work as an IT consultant for small businesses, helping them set up and maintain their server infrastructure. I have a keen interest in home automation and spend my free time tinkering with new gadgets and technology. I'm usually online in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. I'm single, and I enjoy urban hiking and exploring the local music scene.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise is primarily self-taught through hands-on experience and online resources. I started tinkering with computers in high school and turned my hobby into a career. I've worked in various tech roles, from support to network administration, which has given me a broad understanding of IT systems.
